acceptance.audioTaste: A grounded four-candidate audio comparison and whole-film audition are required; source labels, waveforms, spectral measurements and successful decoding cannot establish perceived quality.
acceptance.synchronization: Chosen transients align to actual rendered movement/contact within one30fps frame; sound tails respect easing and dialogue space.
acceptance.mixContributors: Exactly frozen music + frozen positioned voice + selected new SFX. OldSFX, oldmaster, premaster and procedural pilots contribute zero samples.
acceptance.protectedInputs: Input hashes/timelines/gain fixed; exact H264 payload copied; prior exports and backups preserved.
